name: ClassBench
intro: ClassBench 并非独立基准，而是 Agent World Model 论文发布的 1,000 个合成环境之一，表示“音乐学校排课与考勤”场景；它包含由 AWM 流水线生成的任务、SQLite 状态、MCP 工具和验证逻辑。
org: Snowflake AI Research, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
build_method: AWM场景合成, 每场景10个任务, SQLite数据库, MCP工具接口, 状态差异验证
metric: 任务成功奖励, Environment Error
eval_feature: 可执行有状态环境, 数据库一致性, 多轮工具使用, 代码增强验证
scale: AgentWorldModel-1K中的1个环境；每个场景生成10个任务
build_method_en: AWM scenario synthesis, 10 tasks per scenario, SQLite state, MCP tools, and before/after-state verification
eval_feature_en: Executable stateful environment, database consistency, multi-turn tool use, code-augmented verification
intro_en: ClassBench is not a standalone benchmark; it is one of 1,000 synthetic environments released by the Agent World Model paper, representing Music School Scheduling and Attendance with generated tasks, SQLite state, MCP tools, and verification logic.
scale_en: One environment in AgentWorldModel-1K; 10 tasks are generated per scenario

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2602.10090v3 Figure 2, §§3.1–3.3, Appendix A, and Table 15, with the official AgentWorldModel repository pinned at commit 85e322f69279e3b3325b7377ec3bab788514e9cb and the Snowflake/AgentWorldModel-1K dataset pinned at revision dde80a0283fe781bdc51656bce57063dc5650213. Official repository file locators: awm/core/pipeline.py and awm/core/verifier.py. Official dataset file locators: gen_scenario.jsonl, gen_tasks.jsonl, gen_db.jsonl, gen_spec.jsonl, gen_envs.jsonl, and gen_verifier.jsonl. The released record is scenario ID scheduling_2: ClassBench, Music School Scheduling & Attendance. It is one AWM environment with 10 tasks, not a standalone benchmark. The diagram preserves the 100-seed expansion, CRUD/cosine-0.85/category-cap filtering, task-conditioned SQLite/interface/verifier dependencies, isolated execution thresholds, error-summary retry loop capped at five attempts, 1,000-environment/10,000-task release context, and the four paper-defined outcome labels.
